_about: Disclosure gate ledger (competitor review R02, 3 Oct 2026). scripts/check-claims.mjs scans the built HTML for placeholders ([TBC], TODO, lorem) and for figures (percentages, multipliers, x-fold). Every figure on a page must be listed here; a production build (SITE_ENV=production) fails on any placeholder, any unlisted figure and any listed figure that is not signed off. Other builds only report. To sign off: set signedOff to true and fill by and date. Not served: this file lives outside public/.

claims.what: Peer-reviewed modelled analysis (Hebenstreit, Convalexius et al., Scientific Reports 2026), the second evidence line under the film: even with thinking 100× faster, lab time becomes the bottleneck.
The six forecast probabilities of forecast registry v0.2 (and the chart's 50% and 100% axis labels), on the forecast card that /writings and the essays' Next cards show, and in the forecast essay.
claims.note: HANDOFF item 3 and the 9 Sep disclosure doc (sensitive forecasts): the founder signs off publishing the probabilities, or they come off the card and the essay before production.

claims.what: Cited external figures in the forecast essay (each with a numbered reference): benchmark cost trends, trial success rates, the Narayanan et al. 3–30× range, the cost-per-gram reduction and others.
claims.note: Goes with forecast-probabilities: sign off both together.

claims.what: Not a claim: the media-blend arithmetic in the PBMC figure caption (100% − DMEM − RPMI-1640).
Not a claim: a parameter of the live simulation (measurement noise of 2% of the test function's range), stated in footnote 2.

The data-room manifesto, published verbatim on the founder's call (4 Oct 2026). '5×' is ProviGen's own preliminary pilot figure (sample efficiency). '40%' is the OpenAI/Ginkgo preprint's cost reduction per gram of sfGFP in cell-free synthesis versus the best published value (reference 8 says so). 14 Oct 2026: the 5× pilot figure left with the investor sections; only the third-party 40% (OpenAI and Ginkgo preprint, cited) remains, signed off by Lucas Mair.
claims.note: Founder: sign off the 5× pilot figure (methodology packet: baseline, scope, n) and the 40% wording before production, or reword.

claims.what: Frey et al. (bioRxiv preprint v3, Nov 2025, Genentech/Roche): the share of designs binding at least 3x better than their seed rose from about 2% in round 1 to over 21% in round 4 (p. 8, Table 1). Third-party result, attributed on the page.
claims.note: Third-party figure; founder signs off before production (preprint status re-checked at publish time).

claims.what: DeMeo et al., Science 2025: megakaryocyte hit rate 19.6% for model-ranked compounds vs 1.1% for random picks (in vitro, small random arm). Third-party result, attributed on the page.
claims.note: Third-party figure; founder signs off before production.

claims.what: ProviGen's own case study from the founders' Merck LNP deck (slide 7, 8 Oct 2026): enzymatic assay optimisation with an industry partner on two robotic HTS workcells, ~200 samples with DoE against ~40 with active learning, assay precision about 30% better. The deck's ~$10k-per-round saving and '5x' are not on the page.
claims.note: Founder signs off publishing ProviGen figures (CLAUDE.md: no ProviGen metrics without it); the partner approves the wording; Lucas names the precision measure (CV?). The ~200 and ~40 counts are not caught by the scanner but belong to this claim.

manual: The film (public/assets/v3/film.mp4) shows a baked-in 'Status · TBC' in stage 03: re-render it with the confirmed status before production (HANDOFF).
Instrument classes in the hero subline stay out until engineering confirms them.
